title: MyriadBench Task Unit
description: Smallest verifiable unit of work. Belongs to an open family registry.

family.description: Family id from the open registry, e.g. research_memo

brief.description: User-facing task description (what the user says/asks).

background.description: Context injected with the assignment (world hints).

time_budget_min.description: Simulated minutes allotted for the unit.

depends_on.description: State-web obligations: this unit consumes artifacts produced by others.

checkpoints.description: Sub-verifier objects for mid-task milestones (used by Switch Cost probes).
